mintAuthority.summary: Bera USD (BUSD, formerly HONEY) is minted by the Berachain HoneyFactory against whitelisted collateral vaults. Both the token and HoneyFactory are UUPS proxies, and the same 3/5 Berachain Safe retains DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for immediate upgrades and HoneyFactory parameter administration.

controls.label: HoneyFactory mint hub
controls.capDescription: HONEY mints only when whitelisted stablecoin collateral is deposited through the HoneyFactory into per-asset vaults; Basket Mode restricts mint/redeem when a collateral asset depegs.
controls.evidence: At Berachain block 26911429, HoneyFactory's EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0xb587f98c81c37432067060196ac1ddaec106ed8d and the correct EIP-1967 admin slot was zero. hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xd13948f99525fb271809f45c268d72a3c00a568d) returned true. The prior implementation at block 23484618 was 0x6331f0a4e0220a14be27bd31af091f0a1ac036a1.

controls.label: Berachain HoneyFactory admin (3/5 Safe)
controls.evidence: At Berachain block 26911429, the Safe retained the same five owners, threshold 3, no enabled modules, version 1.3.0, zero guard, and fallback handler 0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4. hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, Safe) returned true on both the BUSD token and HoneyFactory. The historical block 23484618 observations remain consistent.

review.evidence: At Berachain block 26911429, BUSD and HoneyFactory implementation slots returned 0x33260b0b0a81dbb6d23509dcdc5f321cb585f22a and 0xb587f98c81c37432067060196ac1ddaec106ed8d; correct EIP-1967 admin slots were zero. The unchanged 3/5 Safe retained DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on both proxies, without enabled modules or guard. Current verified implementation sources retain factory-gated issuance and admin-authorized upgrades. The prior implementations at block 23484618 were 0x96b1a552a97da5503343d0f9ff2766c616e62905 and 0x6331f0a4e0220a14be27bd31af091f0a1ac036a1.
